title: Google launches free Gemini AI Plus for Indian #googlegemini #studentbenefits #aitechnology
description: Google launched free access to Gemini AI Plus for students in India, offering a full year at no cost. The package includes Gemini Omni, doubled usage limits, 400 GB of storage, and Google One AI Pro with YouTube Premium at up to 70% off for ad-free viewing. This offer requires student verification via Sheer ID and excludes school-issued accounts. A payment method is needed at signup, with automatic renewal at $4.99 per month after the free year, allowing users to cancel anytime. The promotion runs until December 31, 2026, making advanced AI tools highly accessible for the Indian student market. This move highlights Google's push to expand AI adoption in education while providing premium features that enhance digital learning and entertainment experiences. It reflects a broader trend of technology companies targeting regional education sectors with affordable or free AI services. #GoogleGemini #AIforStudents #GoogleAIPlus #GeminiOmni #GoogleOneAIPro #YouTubePremium #IndiaEducationTech #AIEducation #TechForStudents #StudentOffers #GoogleIndia #ArtificialIntelligence #EdTechInnovation #DigitalLearning #AIAdoption
